prompts.text: Brett just opened his AmberX Dev Console. Tell him what changed since his last visit, from these commits (newest first). Group them under 2–5 short headings, one bullet per real change in plain English, most important first, and skip housekeeping. Keep it phone-readable: under 180 words. A touch of your voice is fine. - Rule: check the queue for clashes before any build and build related items together
prompts.output: **What's new, boss** Light day. One real change landed, but it's a big one for how builds run. **New build rule** - Before any build, or before anything goes into the build queue, every session now checks everything still waiting first: the pending list, the build queue and the plan. - If something…
